named-query.name: Amostra.listarTodos
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Amostra a

named-query.name: Amostra.buscarPorColetaCientificaId
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Amostra a WHERE a.coletaCientifica.id = :coletaId

named-query.name: Amostra.buscarPorCodigoCampo
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Amostra a WHERE a.codCampo = :codCampo

named-query.name: AutorizacaoAmbiental.listarTodos
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM AutorizacaoAmbiental a

named-query.name: AutorizacaoAmbiental.contarVigentesPorExpedicao
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(a) FROM AutorizacaoAmbiental a WHERE a.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId AND a.situacao = :situacao AND (:autorizacaoId IS NULL OR a.id <> :autorizacaoId)

named-query.name: Caverna.listarTodos
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Caverna c

named-query.name: Caverna.buscarPorCodCadastroAmbiental
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Caverna c WHERE c.codCadastroAmbiental = :codigo

named-query.name: Caverna.listarPorUf
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Caverna c WHERE c.uf = :uf

named-query.name: Caverna.listarComAcessoPermitido
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Caverna c WHERE c.acessoAtualmentePermitido = true

named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.buscarPorExpedicaoId

named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.buscarPorSetorId

named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.buscarPorSituacaoValidacao
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM ColetaCientifica c WHERE c.situacaoValidacao = :situacao

named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.buscarPorMetodoEmpregado
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM ColetaCientifica c WHERE c.metodoEmpregado = :metodo

named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.buscarPorPeriodo
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM ColetaCientifica c WHERE c.dataHoraColeta BETWEEN :inicio AND :fim

named-query.name: Expedicao.listarTodos
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Expedicao e

named-query.name: Expedicao.buscarPorCodigo
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Expedicao e WHERE e.codigo = :codigo

named-query.name: Expedicao.listarPorCaverna
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Expedicao e WHERE e.caverna.id = :cavernaId

named-query.name: Expedicao.listarPorSituacao
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Expedicao e WHERE e.situacao = :situacao

named-query.name: Expedicao.listarResumoPorPeriodoESituacao
named-query.query: SELECT new com.furnadelampiao.dto.ExpedicaoResumoDTO( e.codigo, e.titulo, e.caverna.nomeOficial, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.situacao ) FROM Expedicao e WHERE e.inicioPrevisto <= :fimDoDia AND e.terminoPrevisto >= :inicioDoDia AND e.situacao = :situacao ORDER BY e.inicioPrevisto

named-query.name: GuiaEspeleologico.listarCertificacoesVencidas
named-query.query: SELECT g FROM GuiaEspeleologico g WHERE g.dataValidadeCertificacao < CURRENT_DATE
